archived.description: If true, the tag is archived and not displayed in relevant areas of the Lunch Money app. Defaults to false.

background_color.description: Optional background color of the tag. Pass null to leave it unset.

description.description: Optional description. Up to 200 characters. Pass null to leave it empty.

name.description: Name of the tag. 1-100 characters. Must not match the name of an existing tag.

text_color.description: Optional text color of the tag. Pass null to leave it unset.
